response: The ambulatory process of care is a significant predictor of health-related quality of life outcomes for patients with chronic disease. Research has demonstrated a substantial relationship between better ambulatory process of care and improved health-related quality of life. This suggests that efforts to enhance the process of care can have a positive impact on the overall well-being of patients with chronic conditions. Therefore, it is essential to focus on improving the ambulatory process of care to achieve better health-related quality of life outcomes for these patients.
